{'text': '今年較早前為較年幼嘅學童推出咗家長管理帳戶之後，WhatsApp 今日將家長監控功能擴展至青少年帳戶，新增咗群組活動提示同埋對 Meta AI 嘅額外限制。以下係詳細內容。', 'target': 'Earlier this year, WhatsApp introduced parent-managed accounts for younger students, and today, the platform is expanding parental supervision tools to teen accounts, adding group activity alerts and additional restrictions on Meta AI. Here are the details.'}

{'text': 'WhatsApp 擴大家長監控選項', 'target': 'WhatsApp Expands Parental Supervision Options'}

{'text': 'Earlier this year, WhatsApp announced a series of new features aimed at giving parents more control over the accounts of their younger students.', 'target': '今年較早前，WhatsApp 公布咗一系列新功能，旨在畀家長對其較年幼學童嘅帳戶有更大嘅控制權。'}

{'text': 'These included letting parents decide who could contact the account, as well as which groups the account could join, screening message requests from unknown contacts, and protecting privacy settings on managed accounts through a parent-set PIN.', 'target': '當中包括畀家長決定邊個可以聯絡該帳戶，以及帳戶可以加入邊啲群組、審查來自未知聯絡人嘅訊息請求，並透過家長設定嘅 PIN 碼保護，管理帳戶嘅私隱設定。'}

{'text': 'Then, a few weeks ago, WhatsApp further extended the feature to iOS, adding a dedicated "Parental Supervision" section within the Settings app to make it easier for parents to find and configure managed accounts.', 'target': '之後，喺幾個星期前，WhatsApp 進一步將呢項功能擴展至 iOS，喺設定 App 加入咗一個專屬嘅「家長監控」部分，令家長更容易搵到同設定受管理嘅帳戶。'}

{'text': 'Today, WhatsApp is once again expanding these supervision features — this time bringing parental monitoring to teens, not just younger students — while also giving them higher visibility into group activity and more say over how their teens interact with Channels, Status updates, and (perhaps more importantly) Meta AI.', 'target': '今日，WhatsApp 再一次擴大呢啲監控功能，今次係將家長監控帶到青少年，而不僅僅係較年幼嘅學童，同時畀家長對群組活動有更高嘅可見度，以及對佢哋嘅青少年點樣同 Channels、Status 更新，以及（可能更重要嘅）Meta AI 互動有更大嘅話語權。'}

{'text': 'With this update, parents can now receive notifications when their teens join or leave groups, as well as when the membership of an already-joined group grows "significantly." Parents can also now choose how their teens use Channels, who can see their Status updates, and who can view their own Status updates.', 'target': '透過今次更新，家長而家可以喺佢哋嘅青少年加入或離開群組時收到通知，亦可以喺已加入嘅群組「人數顯著增加」時收到通知。家長而家仲可以揀青少年點樣使用 Channels、邊個可以睇到佢哋嘅 Status 更新，以及邊個可以睇到佢哋自己嘅 Status 更新。'}

{'text': 'As for Meta AI, parents can now choose between the standard experience designed for users aged 13 and older, or a stricter "limited content" option, depending on what they feel is appropriate for their teen.', 'target': '至於 Meta AI，家長而家可以喺專為 13 歲或以上用戶設計嘅標準體驗，或者更嚴格嘅「有限內容」選項之間揀選，視乎佢哋認為邊樣適合自己嘅青少年。'}

{'text': 'WhatsApp says the limited setting further restricts the topics teens can discuss with Meta AI. Meta AI features that rely on Private Processing are also unavailable when that setting is enabled.', 'target': 'WhatsApp 表示，有限設定進一步限制咗青少年可以同 Meta AI 討論嘅話題。依賴 Private Processing 嘅 Meta AI 功能喺啟用該設定時亦無法使用。'}

{'text': "As always, WhatsApp stresses that these parental supervision features will not allow parents to see the actual content of their teens' messages or calls, as those communications remain protected by end-to-end encryption.", 'target': 'WhatsApp 同以往一樣強調，呢啲家長監控功能並唔會畀家長睇到青少年實際嘅訊息或通話嘅內容，呢啲通訊仍然受到端對端加密保護。'}

{'text': "For more information on WhatsApp's new managed teen accounts, visit the link below.", 'target': '想了解更多關於 WhatsApp 新嘅受管理青少年帳戶嘅資訊，請瀏覽以下連結。'}
